= AWS CloudTrail
:artifactid: camel-aws-cloudtrail-starter

Receive the management events of an AWS account from Amazon CloudTrail.

== What's inside

* xref:{csb-camel-components}::aws-cloudtrail-component.adoc[AWS CloudTrail component], URI syntax: `aws-cloudtrail:label`

Please refer to the above links for usage and configuration details.

== Maven coordinates

[source,xml]
----
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.camel.springboot</groupId>
    <artifactId>camel-aws-cloudtrail-starter</artifactId>
</dependency>
----

Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown.
